cases.sentence: Во время правления Ирода, царя Иудеи, был ___ по имени Захария, из смены Авия.
cases.translation: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah.
cases.explain: Священник is the subject complement of был (there was) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Был священник по имени Захария, из ___ Авия.
cases.translation: There was a priest named Zechariah, of the division of Abijah.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from/of) takes the genitive → смены.

cases.sentence: Бог послал ангела Гавриила в галилейский город Назарет к ___ по имени Мария.
cases.translation: God sent the angel Gabriel to a Galilean town called Nazareth, to a virgin named Mary.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative → деве.

cases.sentence: Ты забеременеешь и родишь ___ и назовешь его Иисусом.
cases.translation: You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus.
cases.explain: Сына is the direct object of родишь (will bear) → accusative. Сын is animate, so its accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: От самого рождения он будет исполнен Святым ___.
cases.translation: From his mother's womb he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.
cases.explain: Исполнен (filled) governs the instrumental of the thing one is filled with → Духом.

cases.sentence: Они оба были уже в преклонном ___.
cases.translation: They were both already well advanced in years.
cases.explain: В (in), marking a state with no motion, takes the prepositional → возрасте.

reading.ru: Во время правления Ирода, царя Иудеи, был священник по имени Захария, из смены Авия.
reading.question: Who was Zechariah?

reading.correct: A priest from the division of Abijah during Herod's reign

reading.ru: Но у них не было детей, потому что Елизавета была бесплодна.
reading.question: Why did Zechariah and Elizabeth have no children?
options: They had not yet been married long
reading.explain: The text says they had no children because Elizabeth was barren.

reading.ru: Ангел сказал ему, «Не бойся, Захария, твоя молитва услышана. Твоя жена Елизавета родит тебе сына, и ты назовешь его Иоанном».
reading.question: What did the angel tell Zechariah in the temple?
options: That his wife Elizabeth would bear a son named John
That he would become high priest
That the temple would be rebuilt
reading.correct: That his wife Elizabeth would bear a son named John
reading.explain: The angel told Zechariah his prayer was heard and Elizabeth would bear a son named John.

reading.ru: ты лишишься дара речи и не будешь говорить до того дня, пока это не сбудется
reading.question: What happened to Zechariah because he did not believe the angel?
options: He became unable to speak until the prophecy was fulfilled
He was banished from the temple
He lost his position as priest
reading.correct: He became unable to speak until the prophecy was fulfilled
reading.explain: Because Zechariah doubted, the angel said he would lose the power of speech until the day these things happened.

reading.ru: Когда Захария вышел, он не мог говорить и вынужден был общаться с ними жестами.
reading.question: What happened when Zechariah came out of the temple?
options: He could not speak and had to communicate by gestures
He announced the angel's message loudly
He immediately went home to Elizabeth
reading.correct: He could not speak and had to communicate by gestures
reading.explain: When Zechariah came out, he could not speak and had to make signs to the people.

reading.ru: Вскоре его жена Елизавета забеременела и пять месяцев не выходила из дома.
reading.question: What did Elizabeth do after she conceived?
options: She stayed home for five months
She told all her neighbors immediately
She went to live with Mary
reading.correct: She stayed home for five months
reading.explain: After conceiving, Elizabeth remained in seclusion at home for five months.

reading.ru: Ангел пришел к ней и сказал «Приветствую тебя, получившая милость, с тобой Господь».
reading.question: What did the angel Gabriel say when he came to Mary?
options: "Greetings, favored one, the Lord is with you"
"Rejoice, for your son will be a priest"
"Prepare a room for the coming king"
reading.correct: "Greetings, favored one, the Lord is with you"
reading.explain: The angel greeted Mary, saying she had found favor and that the Lord was with her.

reading.ru: Ты забеременеешь и родишь сына и назовешь его Иисусом.
reading.question: What did the angel tell Mary to name her son?
reading.explain: The angel told Mary she would conceive and bear a son and name him Jesus.

reading.ru: «Как это может быть?» — спросила Мария. «Ведь я еще не была с мужчиной».
reading.question: Why was Mary confused by the angel's message?
options: She had not yet been with a man
She was already married to someone else
She thought the angel meant Elizabeth's child
She did not believe angels existed
reading.correct: She had not yet been with a man
reading.explain: Mary asked how this could be, since she had not yet been with a man.

reading.ru: Когда Елизавета услышала приветствие Марии, ребенок внутри у нее встрепенулся.
reading.question: What happened when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting?
reading.explain: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby inside her leaped.

reading.ru: «Благословенно ты среди женщин, и благословен ребенок, которого ты носишь! Чем я заслужила такую милость, что ко мне пришла мать моего Господа?»
reading.question: What did Elizabeth exclaim to Mary?
options: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you carry"
"Why have you come to me now"
reading.correct: "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you carry"
reading.explain: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Elizabeth exclaimed that Mary and her child were blessed.

reading.ru: «Душа моя славит Господа, и дух мой радуется о Боге, Спасителе моем, потому что он увидел смирение своей служанки.
reading.question: How did Mary respond in her song of praise?
options: "My soul glorifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior"
"I am afraid of what will happen to me"
reading.correct: "My soul glorifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior"
reading.explain: Mary's song of praise begins, "My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior."

reading.ru: Но мать ребенка возразила. Нет, его будут звать Иоанном.
reading.question: What did Elizabeth say when neighbors wanted to name the baby after his father?
options: He would be called John instead
He would be called Zechariah after all
He would be named after Abraham
She refused to give him a name
reading.correct: He would be called John instead
reading.explain: The child's mother objected, saying, "No; he will be called John."

reading.ru: Захария попросил табличку для письма и, к удивлению всех, написал его имя Иоанн. В тот же миг к нему вернулась речь, и он начал говорить, прославляя Бога.
reading.question: What happened immediately after Zechariah wrote 'His name is John'?
options: His speech was restored and he began to praise God
reading.correct: His speech was restored and he began to praise God
reading.explain: The moment Zechariah wrote John's name, his speech returned and he began praising God.

reading.ru: «Благословен Господь, Бог Израиля, который посетил свой народ и искупил его.
reading.question: How did Zechariah's prophecy begin?
options: "Blessed be the Lord, God of Israel, who has visited and redeemed his people"
reading.correct: "Blessed be the Lord, God of Israel, who has visited and redeemed his people"
reading.explain: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Zechariah prophesied, beginning, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people."

reading.ru: Ребенок рос и укреплялся в духе. Он жил в пустыне до того времени, когда открыто явился Израиль.
reading.question: What happened to John as he grew up?
options: He grew and became strong in spirit, living in the wilderness until his public appearance to Israel
He was raised in the temple by priests
He moved to Rome with his parents
He became a fisherman in Galilee
reading.correct: He grew and became strong in spirit, living in the wilderness until his public appearance to Israel
reading.explain: The child grew and became strong in spirit, living in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.
